primary.agency_or_establishment: Department of Housing and Urban Development
primary.records_schedule_applies_to: All records related to the Section 8 Housing Choice Voucher Program
primary.major_subdivision: Office of Public and Indian Housing
primary.schedule_subject: Disposition of Section 8 Housing Program Records
primary.internal_agency_concurrences: Concurrences received from the Office of the Chief Information Officer and the Office of General Counsel
